content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues to roll out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

New chat bubble design gets a more rounded look

Months ago, WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly, after months of testing and refinement with select users via TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted hints in the app's code suggesting that WhatsApp's chat bubbles would be redesigned. The site now reports that the new bubble design is starting to roll out to some users on the latest TestFlight build.

Here's what WABetaInfo has to report:

In addition to the redesigned shape of message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links appear in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, making photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more seamless.

According to WABetaInfo, the new look is currently only available to a select group of users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version, and there is no timeline yet for a full rollout to all iOS users.
